name: reverseplugin
description: Native binary and game-engine analysis, process memory, and debugging tools exposed through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Native binary, engine, memory, and debugging tools over MCP.
interface.longDescription: A native C++23 MCP server for static PE and game-engine analysis, structured Zydis disassembly, function and cross-reference discovery, persistent annotations, validated process-memory access, stack walking, and Win32 debugging. Engine workspaces identify and index Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, Source, Source 2, CRYENGINE, and Cocos2d-x installations without launching them; Unity IL2CPP v38/v39 adds direct method-to-native mapping.
defaultPrompt: Open a PE binary and build a structured analysis plan.
Dump Unity IL2CPP metadata and map methods to GameAssembly addresses.
Identify a game engine and inventory its native modules and content containers.
Inspect a Windows process without modifying it.
